# volcano_user_git_installation_repositories (Data Source)

Repositories reachable through a GitHub App installation, used to find repository_id/repo_full_name for volcano_project_git_connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_user_git_installation_repositories" "example" {
  connection_id   = "conn_123"
  installation_id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String)
- `installation_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `repositories` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `default_branch` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_empty` (Boolean)
- `private` (Boolean)
